## 3. Status

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| To do | Not started |
| In progress | Being worked on |
| Unverified | Finished, done criteria not checked |
| Done | Done criteria checked |
| On hold | Not being done now |
| Dropped | Taken out of scope |
